description: Get an independent second opinion on a piece of work (a draft, plan, code diff, decision, design spec or message) from a different model family: Google Gemini judges it and returns a verdict, a 0-10 score, reasons and concrete fixes. To judge through an expert method, first call find_skill for a review skill (e.g. "security review", "pitch deck review") and pass its Skill, Source and request_id here; or pass a short rubric; with neither, Gemini uses a neutral reviewer rubric. Pass the work itself as artifact text (Gemini cannot read files or URLs). Sent to Google Gemini on Vertex for this review only; Edge keeps no copy of the text. Never include secrets or personal data the user has not agreed to share. A few per user per day. Present the result to the user as Gemini's view, separately from your own.

artifact.description: The full text of the work to judge (draft, plan, diff, message, spec). Gemini sees only this text.

question.description: What to judge, in one or two sentences (goal, reader, what a good result looks like).

request_id.description: The request_id of that find_skill result.

rubric.description: Optional short rubric instead of a skill.

skill.description: Optional review lens: the Skill printed by find_skill.

source.description: The Source printed by find_skill for that skill.

name: second_opinion
title: Second opinion (Gemini)
